title: chore(storybook): migrate dev-novel to storybook
body:
This migrates our stories from `dev-novel` to `storybook`.

The global environment variable `__DEV__` respects the storybook environment (set to `false` when deployed and `true` when developing).

Link to storybook: https://deploy-preview-3376--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/stories

Closes #3051

***

⚠️ This will need to be deployed (therefore merged) at the same time as the corresponding documentation deployment after having updated the story links in the doc.
